newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Aznar says Dec CPI data "excellent".
newsitem.headline: Spain's Aznar says Dec CPI data "excellent".

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar said on Wednesday that December consumer price data were "excellent".
In an interview with Spanish national radio, Aznar said: "The number is excellent...It means that the Spanish economy is credible."
Spanish CPI rose 0.3 percent month-on-month in December, for a 3.2 percent year-on-year rate, the latter being unchanged from that in November.

Aznar added the decline in the Spanish bono yield spread to the German Bund to historic lows below 100 basis points is the best indication of the confidence inspired by the Spanish economy. The spread reached a new low this morning of 90 basis points.
